notes.title: development on hold due to health issues!
notes.content:
I had to put the development of Critters on hold, due to health issues, which currently I don't know when exactly they will be resolved. 
I'm planning on continuing Critters after my recovery, but until then I asked Steam to remove the buy option from the store and unlist the game.
Everyone who already owned the game, can still play it though.

I hope in around a year I will be able to tell more accurately when the development will continue and until then I will fully focus on my recovery.

Thank you everyone who has been supporting me and those who bought the game and gave me a lot of precious feedback.

kindly
Farelle from Embersparkz

notes.title: Patchnotes 22/12/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30975245/87872cb8c4920d32179330b0a5f379dc8849518e.png[/img]
[list]
 [*] fixed color adaptation to actually shift color gradually towards biome color
 [*] sparkles for cub selection (to start next generation)
 [*] tornado removed (will be reintroduced when I add and fix weather system)
 [*] added snow biome content (trees, bushes, rocks and fruits! Yummy Cinnabuns :3 )
 [*] fixed respawn sometimes going to next generation (hopefully)
 [*] cub selection is now yellow (more visible on snow)
 [*] added grass and flowers all over the place
 [*] fixed temperature issue from hot climate, it should now go down when leaving desert
 [*] added grasslands music
 [*] added main menu and loading screen
 [*] Options menu is now functional (currently has only volume as options and it doesn't save when leaving the game)
 [*] cubs should not be able to spawn in den walls anymore
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix for major respawn issues
notes.content:
I just uploaded several hotfixes for the game, seems like some bugs were sneaking past me that really shouldn't have ;)

[u]patchnotes hotfix:[/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Cubs should respawn in a sensible amount (6-12)
[*] [b]Cubs should be able to die now
[*] [b]Tornado stops hugging the world borders and is now accessable and more furious
[*] [b]Inheritance of colors was screwed through biome adapation process, should be fixed now
[*] [b]Tornado generally moves more around map aswell[/b]
[/list]

if you find anything game breaking, please write a post in the bug report forums, I appreciate the help ^^
